name: Wand of Wonder

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Wonder
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: choose a target within 120 ft and roll on the Wand of Wonder table to see what happens.

summary: 7 charges: point it at a creature and something unpredictable happens (a d100 table).
text: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 of its charges while choosing a point, object or creature within 120 feet of you. The target must be one you can see. Roll 1d100 on the Wand of Wonder table to discover what happens: anything from slowing the target or wrapping it in Faerie Fire, to fireballs, lightning, a storm of butterflies, a cloud of gas, grass sprouting around you or the wielder turning invisible. Spells cast from the wand have a save DC of 15. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into dust and is destroyed.
